Delivery

Next-day delivery, AM or PM

We take charge of your shipments with guaranteed next-day delivery, in the morning or the afternoon.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

For shipments that are not urgent but must arrive at a specific time, our next-day service offers the best balance of speed and price. Hand us your parcels or pallets today; we deliver them tomorrow in the time window you choose: before noon or in the afternoon.

What’s included

  • Next-day delivery, AM window (before 12 p.m.) or PM window (12 to 5 p.m.)
  • Anywhere in Quebec from Greater Montreal
  • Regular routes for retailers and distributors
  • Pallet delivery with pallet jack or liftgate as needed
  • Proof of delivery available on request

How it works

  1. Book before 4 p.m.

    Send us your request the day before: number of parcels or pallets, weight, addresses and preferred time window.

  2. Same-day pickup

    We collect the goods at your warehouse, store or home at the end of the day.

  3. Delivered tomorrow

    Your shipment is delivered in the agreed AM or PM window, with confirmation.

FAQ

FAQ — next-day delivery, am or pm

What is the cut-off time for next-day delivery?

Requests received before 4 p.m. are usually picked up the same day and delivered the next day. After that, call us: there is often still room.

Do you deliver outside Montreal?

Yes, anywhere in Quebec. Next-day delivery applies to most destinations; for remote regions, we confirm the date when you book.

Can you do recurring deliveries for my business?

Yes. Many of our business customers give us a fixed daily or weekly route at an agreed rate. Tell us about your volumes.

Do you take pallets?

Yes, standard and oversized pallets. Let us know whether the delivery address has a loading dock; if not, we come with a liftgate.
